page.overview:
Who is Bubbles?

Bubbles is a female Velociraptor that can be seen at the Raptor Encounter at Universal Studios Singapore. She was first displayed at the park in September 2015. She seemed to have replaced Patsy who used to be at the attraction, and seems to have since been replaced by Blue.

Bubbles was able to be seen by guests as she stood in a trailer. Guests were able to take photos and videos of the raptor while a nearby handler told facts about Velociraptors.
